title: 第1815章 预热战将启第1814章 仙古战区
slug: 穿书女频大婚当日被女主杀死
content_zh:
这两大天域之中并无太多族群，已然变成战场，其中剩余的生灵已被移走。
若是太阳神州与古仙院在天域之中厮杀，倒是不会过多波及到外界。
叶凌天看向原始道祖和永恒帝尊：“众生之城与永恒帝庭的入口就在天域之门，古仙域的入口也在那里，若是古仙院对众生之城和永恒帝庭出手，你们能否反应呢？”
众生之城，都是亡灵，如今皆由原始道祖掌控，他倒是不担心。
但永恒帝庭不同，里面生灵众多，且如今站在了古仙院的对立面。
若是古仙院趁机从天域之门动手，率先杀入永恒天域，永恒帝尊不见得可以反应过来。
即使反应过来，估计永恒天域里面的生灵，也得死伤无数。
原始道祖道：“众生之城与我一体，我在哪里它就在哪里，无须担心。”
永恒帝尊笑着道：“我永恒天域那边已布置好！我已斩断永恒天域的入口，且封锁了永恒天域，此后从天域之门，难以入我永恒帝庭，唯有直接从太阳神城的传送阵，才可进入其中。”
九大天域的入口都处在天域之门，但也只是入口处在那里，真正的所在地离天域之门极远。
九大天域之间，每一个都相隔遥远的距离，且有界壁阻拦，想要跨越，可没那么简单。
叶凌天淡笑道：“若是如此，那就稳了！到时候倾尽全力抵挡古仙院即可。”
沐雪漓道：“之前北洛璃现身的时候，她道出一些事情，据她所言，太阳神州与古仙院这一战，不得不打。”
“如今古仙院依旧有些忌惮上苍，仙道之力并未过分侵蚀外界，但若是太阳神州这个阵营败北了，到时候仙道之力会侵蚀九大天域、侵蚀八百神州、侵蚀整个上苍界，乃至道界、九州。”
太阳神州与古仙院的战区已然划定，双方迟早会打一仗。
这一战，不单单是太阳神州与古仙院的大战，还是八百神州、天域生灵与仙族的大战。
北洛璃的声音，天盟之中八百神州的强者，皆听到了。
这些道统强者都明白其中的关键，那就是此刻的他们，已然没有条件去置身事外，唯有倾尽全力，与太阳神州打上这一仗。
若是败了，太阳神州会灭，他们所在的道统，也会覆灭。
叶凌天道：“既然要打，那就打！眼下的太阳神州，无惧古仙院丝毫。”

现在的他，晋级道尊一境，各大底牌齐出，绝对可以超越道尊境，遇上仙帝级别的强者，他亦可无惧丝毫。
古仙院要战，他亦是奉陪到底！
待到时候铲除古仙院、冥土、道族，将那些强者全部炼化，他就杀入十八重天。
他倒是要看看，对上深不可测的上苍，是否可以一战！
原始道祖道：“此事我们已经与天盟各大道统之人商议过，他们也不惧战，若是到时候真的开战，他们也会倾尽全力。”
永恒帝尊看向叶凌天，问道：“仙古战区划定之后，古仙院、冥土、道族三大阵营，都在战区之中，开辟出了前线战城，如今已有强者和大军镇守其中，太阳神州，是否也得在战区之中开辟出前线战城呢？”
叶凌天道：“战城可以开辟，但无须派强者镇守，太阳神州的情况与古仙院的不同，古仙院之中，如今汇聚着冥土和道族之人，成员众多，他们有的是人镇守城池。”
“而太阳神州，核心在于天盟，成员有限，不用过多消耗，到时候若要厮杀，出动天盟即可，至于其余人，实力若是不到，入了战场，也只会殒命，完全没必要去牺牲。”
镇守城池，那肯定需要很多人，天盟之中的人加起来也不到五千，派去守城，完全没这个必要。
太阳神州与古仙院的厮杀，并非世俗之战，自然也不能使用寻常的人肉战术。
在真正的强者面前，人再多也没啥用，若是让大量修为弱的人去镇守，到时候厮杀起来，只会让人枉送性命罢了。
content_en:
There are not many ethnic groups in these two worlds. They have become battlefields and the remaining creatures have been removed.
If Taiyang Shenzhou and Guxianyuan were fighting in the Heaven Realm, it would not affect the outside world too much.
Ye Lingtian looked at the original Taoist Ancestor and the Eternal Emperor: "The entrance to the City of All Living Beings and the Eternal Emperor's Court is at the Gate of Heaven, and the entrance to the Ancient Immortal Domain is also there. If the Ancient Immortal Academy takes action against the City of All Living Beings and the Eternal Emperor's Court, can you respond?"
The city of all living beings are all undead, and now they are all controlled by the original Taoist ancestors, so he is not worried.
But the Eternal Imperial Court is different. There are many creatures in it, and they are now standing on the opposite side of the Ancient Immortal Courtyard.
If the Ancient Immortal Academy takes the opportunity to attack from the Gate of Heaven Realm and take the lead in entering the Eternal Heaven Realm, the Eternal Emperor may not be able to react.
Even if they react, it is estimated that the creatures in the Eternal Sky Realm will suffer countless casualties.
The original Taoist ancestor said: "The city of all living beings is one with me. It is where I am, so there is no need to worry."
The Eternal Emperor smiled and said: "My Eternal Heaven Realm has been arranged! I have cut off the entrance to the Eternal Heaven Realm and sealed the Eternal Heaven Realm. From now on, it will be difficult to enter my Eternal Imperial Court from the gate of the Heaven Realm. The only way to enter it is directly from the teleportation array of the Sun God City."
The entrances to the nine heavenly realms are all at the gate of the heavenly realm, but it is only at the entrance. The real location is far away from the gate of the heavenly realm.
Each of the nine heavenly realms is separated by a huge distance and blocked by boundary walls. It is not that simple to cross.
Ye Lingtian smiled lightly and said: "If that's the case, then it's stable! Then we can use all our strength to resist the Ancient Immortal Academy."
Mu Xueli said: "When Bei Luoli appeared before, she told something. According to her, the battle between Taiyang Divine State and Ancient Immortal Academy has to be fought."
"Today, the Ancient Immortal Academy is still somewhat afraid of God. The power of the Immortal Way has not excessively eroded the outside world. However, if the Sun Divine State camp is defeated, then the power of the Immortal Way will erode the nine heavens, erode the 800 Divine States, erode the entire Heaven Realm, and even the Dao Realm and Kyushu."
The battle zone between Taiyang Shenzhou and Guxianyuan has been demarcated, and the two sides will fight sooner or later.
This battle is not only a battle between the Taiyang Divine State and the Ancient Immortal Academy, but also a battle between the Eight Hundred Divine States, the creatures of the heavenly realm and the immortal clan.
Bei Luoli's voice was heard by all the eight hundred powerful people in the Heavenly Alliance.
These Taoist powerhouses all understand the key, that is, at this moment, they no longer have the conditions to stay out of the matter. They can only devote all their efforts to fight this battle with the Sun State.
If they lose, the Sun State will be destroyed, and the orthodoxy they belong to will also be destroyed.
Ye Lingtian said: "Since we want to fight, let's fight! The current Taiyang State has no fear of the Ancient Immortal Academy."
Now that he has advanced to the level of Dao Zun, he can definitely surpass the level of Dao Zun with all his trump cards, and he will not be afraid at all when meeting powerful people at the level of Immortal Emperor.
The Ancient Immortal Academy is about to fight, and he will accompany him to the end!
When the time comes to eradicate the Ancient Immortal Academy, Netherland, and Tao Clan, and refine all those strong men, he will reach the eighteenth level.
He wanted to see if he could fight against the unfathomable God!
The original Taoist ancestor said: "We have discussed this matter with the people of the various Dao lineages of the Tianmeng. They are not afraid of war. If a war really starts, they will use all their strength."
The Eternal Emperor looked at Ye Lingtian and asked: "After the Immortal Ancient War Zone was demarcated, the three major camps of Ancient Immortal Academy, Netherland, and Dao Clan all opened up frontline battle cities in the war zone. Now that there are strong men and large armies guarding it, does Taiyang Divine State also have to open up frontline battle cities in the war zone?"
Ye Lingtian said: "The war city can be opened, but there is no need to send strong men to guard it. The situation in the Sun State is different from that of the Ancient Immortal Academy. In the Ancient Immortal Academy, people from the Netherland and Tao tribes are now gathered. There are many members, and they have many people to guard the city."
"As for the Sun State, the core is the Tianmeng. It has limited members and does not need to consume too much.If you want to fight at that time, you can just dispatch the Tianmeng. As for the rest of the people, if they are not strong enough, they will only die when they enter the battlefield. There is no need to sacrifice. "
Guarding the city would definitely require a lot of people. The total number of people in the Tianmen Alliance was less than five thousand. It was completely unnecessary to send them to guard the city.
The fight between Taiyang Shenzhou and Guxianyuan is not a secular battle, and naturally it cannot use ordinary human flesh tactics.
In front of a truly strong person, no matter how many people there are, it is useless. If a large number of people with weak cultivation skills are allowed to guard the area, and they start fighting, it will only lead to wasted lives.
